drc-legal-force-contract.public: No additional source detail was delivered.
drc-legal-force-contract.mandate: On 27 June 2023, the Council extended the Group of Experts mandate to 1 August 2024.
drc-legal-force-contract.review: On 27 June 2023, the Council unanimously adopted French draft S/2023/469 as resolution 2688 (2023), with 15 votes in favour. The Council intended to review the Experts mandate and act on a possible further extension by 1 July 2024.
drc-legal-force-contract.reports: On 27 June 2023, the Council requested a midterm report to the Council after discussion with the Committee by 30 December 2023 and a final report by 15 June 2024.
drc-legal-force-contract.updates: The Group was to send monthly updates to the Committee except in the two report-due months.
